static_traits.name: Dai Bowen
static_traits.medical_history: Never received psychotherapy, no significant physical illness history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe own feelings and thoughts; rather negative attitude, repeated Self-doubt; acceptable cooperation; Not mentioned speech rate and logic abnormalities

basic_info.main_problem: Participated in a talent show singing audition, but firmly believing winning is impossible, this thought triggering Self-doubt and Anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking help because Self-doubt and Anxiety intensified and affect daily life and confidence, hoping to reduce the impact of Anxiety and Self-doubt.

special_situations.event: A singing audition for a talent show (an unfamiliar and high-pressure experience)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If unable to win, it means I am not good enough, this attempt has no meaning
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeking comfort and affirmation from relatives and friends, to counter uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Having no chance of winning at all

special_situations.event: In daily life, thinks about talent shows or one's own singing ability
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the result cannot be ensured as winning, it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly worrying and rehearsing failure scenarios, avoiding in-depth discussion of Self-doubt and Anxiety with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should not have gone to the audition, I will fail

special_situations.event: Comparing one's talent with other competitors'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as good as them, it proves I am not good enough, should not compete
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-focusing on others' performance, lowering confidence, seeking external recognition to ease unease
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I simply cannot compete with them

special_situations.event: Receiving praise for singing from strangers on karaoke night
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only formal competition evaluations count, praise in informal settings is unreliable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive evidence, continuing to hold negative beliefs to maintain self-consistent cognition

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to prove oneself capable (to achieve success)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and Being rejected, worrying about not being recognized
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety by negating positive evidence and seeking external comfort, avoiding facing the risk of possible failure

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough competitor who may fail at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges or more talented others

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out positive feedback (such as praise from strangers) or suggests viewing the audition from a more balanced perspective
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing this evidence is unrepresentative or biased, only formal competition judges' evaluations count
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Calm but insistent tone, emphasizes reasons such as 'it is just entertainment' and 'they are biased', avoiding the emotional impact of positive evaluations.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about comparisons with others or possible failure outcomes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing the competition as win-or-lose, failing to win equals failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use black-and-white wording, such as 'either win or meaningless', firm tone, refusing to explore middle possibilities.

manifestations: Seeing winning the competition as an important standard of self-worth; if unable to win, tending to negate self ('I am never good enough')
Although having a few close friends, unwilling to discuss Self-doubt and Anxiety, emotions hard for others to see and resonate with

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated Self-denial ('I am never good enough')
Unwilling to discuss Self-doubt and Anxiety with friends

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Viewing winning competitions as the core standard for judging self-worth
Tends to use others' judgment as the only measure of ability

exception_events.target_problem: When thinking of talent shows or evaluating singing ability, the client usually develops strong Self-doubt and Anxiety, and negates own ability.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At several karaoke nights, strangers praised his singing, gaining positive external feedback, contrasting with the dominant narrative of 'no one recognizes / impossible to win'.
exception_events.reason: Different situation: informal, low-pressure environments make it easier to perform and be seen by others; supporting clues: immediate positive feedback from people on site.

positive_force: Has some singing ability (has been praised by strangers)
Dares to try and step out of the comfort zone (attending auditions)
Willing to seek help and try cognitive Interventions like reality testing
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent
Excessive comparison with others, seeking external validation
Anxiety and Sleep affected, worsening the negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic Anticipation of talent show results and Self-denial, accompanied by Anxiety and Sleep affected
antecedent: Thinking about the talent show or own singing ability
Being in situations of evaluating and comparing others
target_behavior.core_reason: The unfamiliar high-pressure situation of the first audition triggering failure Fear, and Self-worth excessively dependent on external evaluation (not winning means not good enough).
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and shame, gaining short-term control and psychological relief through preemptive negation.
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged confidence, Anxiety intensified, Sleep disturbed, declining willingness to discuss troubles with friends.
